responsibility: This header centralizes AArch64 linker-spec fragments for CPU erratum workarounds, currently for Cortex-A53 errata that require linker-side fixes. It translates backend defaults and command-line options like -mfix-cortex-a53-* or -mno-fix-cortex-a53-* into the corresponding --fix-cortex-a53-* linker switches and packages them in AARCH64_ERRATA_LINK_SPEC for inclusion by OS and bare-metal target headers.
